item.title: D&D (Dungeons & Dragons)
item.description: Our Games This section tracks the campaigns from our group’s D&D games. Log your sessions and keep track of the story as it unfolds! About the Game Publisher: Wizards of the Coast Edition: 2024 Edition (5.5e) Scale: Roleplaying — typically 3–4 players plus a Dungeon Master Session Length: Usually 2–4 hours Core Mechanic: Roll a d20, add relevant modifiers, and meet or beat a Difficulty Class (DC) or the target’s Armour Class (AC) Each character has six core ability scores — Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma — which feed into skills, saving throws, and attack rolls.

item.title: Steele's Armory
item.description: Steele’s Armory Read Aloud Heat rolls off the forge before you’re even through the door. An ancient furnace burns at the heart of the workshop, its molten light spilling through vents and washing rows of armour stands in orange.

item.title: Silvers Blades
item.description: Silvers Blades Read Aloud The contrast with the forge across the hall is immediate — cool, quiet, and almost unnervingly clean. Blades hang in perfect symmetry like museum pieces.

item.title: Missy's Magnificent Miscellaneous Merchandise
item.description: Missy’s Magnificent Miscellaneous Merchandise Read Aloud A hand-painted sign creaks above the door: “Good gear. Good sense. Safe travels!” Inside, every shelf is crammed with rope, lanterns, bedrolls, and a hundred small useful things, and the whole shop smells faintly of leather and candle wax.
